card.name: Endings of the word marginal
card.fires_on: The ending (inal, ally, iana) right after the start of 'margin' or 'Marg' as in marginal, marginally, Marginal zone or Margiana. It also fires weakly on '/m' in 'mg/m2'.

modes.label: Marginal / marginally
modes.description: The closing piece of marginal or marginally after 'Marg' or 'margin'.
modes.example: With DDT unavailable, many mosquito-control authorities are depleting their budgets by repeated spraying with short-acting, margin<<ally>> effective insecticides.

modes.label: Marginal in medical terms
modes.description: The ending of 'Marginal' in names such as marginal mandibular nerve or marginal zone lymphoma.
modes.example: Recommended Dosage for Follicular Lymphoma or Marg<<inal>> Zone Lymphoma

modes.label: mg/m2 dose units
modes.description: The '/m' part of a body-surface-area dose unit after mg.

card.plain: It lights up on the final part of the word marginal or marginally, such as in marginal zone lymphoma or marginal mandibular nerve.
